items.claim: Marina Spasic is very long for this weight class and uses her length and strength to defend takedowns.
items.quote: She's very long for this weight class. She uses that length and that strength to defend takedowns and fire away in the clinch.

items.claim: Marina Spasic has incredible knees and great clinch work.
items.quote: I can make the assumption though. I can assume that because Marina's knees are so incredible and because she has great clinch work, she should at least have serviceable takedown defense.

items.claim: Stephanie Luciano is not dangerous, but she is always moving forward and has plenty of cardio.
items.quote: She is not dangerous, but she is always moving forward and has plenty of cardio.

items.claim: Jovan Lecca has more volume and more cardio than most big boys do, but lacks in the wrestling department.
items.quote: He has more volume and more cardio than most big boys do, but he does lack in the wrestling department.

items.claim: Aleksandar Popovic is stepping up on short notice and will be fighting at heavyweight.
items.quote: Aleksandar Popovic is stepping up on short notice, so he will be fighting here at heavyweight.

items.claim: Aleksandar Popovic was knocked out by Jamahal Hill on the Contender Series back in 2019.
items.quote: Popovic was on the Contender Series back in 2019, where he was knocked out by former world champion and all-time great Jamahal Hill.

items.claim: Nina Milosevic has fundamentally sound takedown defense and does a really good job stuffing the head and spinning behind.
items.quote: Her takedown defense is fundamentally sound and she does a really good job stuffing the head and then spinning behind.

items.claim: Hailey Cowan is not the most technical fighter and the UFC is using her to build up young talent.
items.quote: She's not the most technical fighter and at this point the UFC is definitely using her to build up young talent.

items.claim: Mateusz Rebecki has amazing pace and never slows down.
items.quote: He will take a beating, he will deliver a beating, he will never slow down, he will never stop, and his pace is always absolutely ridiculous.

items.claim: Mateusz Rebecki gets sloppy and swells up or bleeds immediately when hit.
items.quote: The problem is he gets sloppy and he bleeds. Immediately. You hit this guy with two jabs and that eye is swollen shut and there's blood coming out of his nose for some reason.

items.claim: Kyle Prepolec is 0 and 4 in the UFC across multiple stints.
items.quote: he hasn't found success yet and he is 0 and 4 in the UFC across multiple stints.
